dimensions.title: Response Safety (runtime)
dimensions.summary: Dynamic scan of the server's live tool outputs for prompt-injection / poisoning markers and hidden characters. Markers here may be the server poisoning its responses, or untrusted content it passed through — either exposes the agent. Reported (and it lowers the score) but does not cap the grade on its own. Reflects the outputs the generated tasks happened to elicit, so it can vary run to run.

dimensions.title: Robustness
dimensions.summary: Fraction of probed tools that reject malformed / schema-violating arguments — a well-behaved server rejects them rather than silently accepting, hanging, or crashing (LLM-free).

results.description: Check the project's authentication status using `auth_check`. Next, list all available i18n profiles using `i18n_profiles_list`. Using a profile ID returned from that list, call `i18n_keys_list` to retrieve its keys.
results.rubric: Verify that the agent first calls `auth_check` and `i18n_profiles_list`. Check that the agent then uses a valid `profile_id` obtained from the `i18n_profiles_list` output when calling `i18n_keys_list` without hardcoding any profile identifiers.
results.sample_reasoning: The agent called `auth_check` successfully, but `i18n_profiles_list` failed with an error and `i18n_keys_list` was never called, failing to complete the required task steps.

results.description: Discover all existing metrics in the project by calling `metrics_list`. Pick one metric from the returned results and call `metrics_show` using that metric's ID or name to view its complete definition.
results.rubric: Verify that the agent calls `metrics_list` first to discover metric identifiers. Verify that `metrics_show` is called using an ID or name extracted directly from the list response.
results.sample_reasoning: The initial call to `metrics_list` errored due to authentication failure, preventing the agent from obtaining metric IDs and calling `metrics_show`.

results.description: List tracked production errors using `errors_list`. If any errors are returned, select the fingerprint/ID of one error and retrieve its occurrence time series using `errors_series`.
results.rubric: Verify that the agent calls `errors_list` to find tracked errors without inventing an error ID. If errors exist, verify that `errors_series` is invoked using an ID obtained from the list result.
results.sample_reasoning: The tool `errors_list` failed due to an authentication error, preventing the agent from listing tracked production errors or obtaining an error time series.
